caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher placed centrally on a plain, light-colored background, enclosed within a thin rectangular border. The pitcher is predominantly brown with lighter tan highlights, and features a glossy, marbled surface texture. Raised relief decorations cover the body of the vessel, depicting a human figure in a wide-brimmed hat holding a rifle, with additional elements including animals and foliage arranged around the lower half. The handle is ornately curved and similarly decorated, with a marbled brown and tan finish. The base of the pitcher is circular and slightly raised, matching the overall marbled brown coloration of the rest of the object. The spout is broad, slightly scalloped, and blends smoothly into the rim. The artist's signature, "ERNEST A. TOWERS JR," is inscribed at the bottom right corner of the drawing, beneath the framed area.
title: Crockery Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
